clue.text: The ancient city is for going around another time

clue.text: In competition final leg rowed at a brisk pace

clue.text: Cockney thieves in their cups?

clue.text: Bitter vetch always available from the bigger suppliers

clue.text: One does not find fault with a learner

a loud bang, as of a gun

clue.text: Jail-bird would loiter

explanation.definitionFit: Old slang for a convict, and to straggle or fall behind.

clue.text: It adversely affects listeners
